0.9.0: setup files (pyproject.toml, pytest.ini, framegate.toml) are edited in the spec phase and committed with "spec OK"; specs can name read-only reference projects and what is ported from them; deploy / CI changes become a pipeline follow-up.
0.8.0: framegate now keeps itself up to date: the command-line tool follows the plugin's version when you start a feature, and you see one line like this after an update.
0.7.0: step checks now run the whole normal test suite, the final checks fail on assertions that never ran, and answers that only take the defaults no longer repeat every check.
